hook.line: This is the perfect AI co-founder for launching a solo startup.
hook.visual: Top half: illustrated retro computer surrounded by 'website, outreach, branding' cards; bottom half: faceless presenter in cap and yellow neck gaiter; title pill 'AI co-founder for your BUSINESS'.

beats.what: Split screen: concept illustration on top, masked presenter below, title pill with a shocked emoji
Top image swaps to a man at a monitor wall as he says 'for launching'
Top shows the product's logo as he names it
Full-frame screen recording of the site on a yellow background: 'Let's build something'
Zoom punch into the 'What's your idea?' input box
Dashboard with task list and an Auto Mode dialog while he lists what it runs
Documents view: daily CEO reports, ads, business stats
Back to the presenter; a fake comment-reply bubble with the product name slides in

why_it_works: A fixed title pill keeps the promise on screen the whole time, so late joiners get the point
Faceless masked presenter is a recognisable brand mark without showing a face
Switches from presenter to full-frame UI after 7 s, showing the steps (type idea, it builds) as proof
Mock comment-reply bubble at the end shows viewers exactly what to type
weaknesses: Screen recordings are small text on white; most UI is unreadable at phone size
Feature list (plans, codes, launches, markets) is told rather than shown with results
Low comment count (73) for 46k plays suggests the comment-for-link CTA undersold
for_robert: Keep a persistent title pill and end on a mock comment bubble with the keyword; Fred could carry that bubble in and point at it.
